verdict.rationale: HumanLayer offers task/session history and draft PR creation with review workflows, giving some sense of tracking and reviewing agent work, but there is no evidence of explicit versioning of automations, diffing between automation versions, or a rollback/revert mechanism for tasks or workflows. missing for 10: explicit automation versioning system, rollback/revert capability for tasks or sessions, changelog/version diff between automation runs, independent confirmation of these features.
